provenance.warning: NOT a harness artifact. These numbers were recorded in the body of commit 21ea9b18d; the run's own machine-readable output was not archived. Transcribed 2026-09-22 so the paper's citations resolve to something a reader can open. Re-run 4.2b to replace this file with a real artifact.

config.method: fixed resident batch, riders added on top; step time by differencing two generation lengths so prefill cancels exactly; pool byte counters read alongside

crossover_gbps.note: recomputed 2026-09-26 from C=8.59 GB (16 residents x 2048 ctx), eta_o=0.62, T=54.10 ms. The 66 in the original commit message is not reproducible from any stated quantity.

notes: riders_created saturates at 2 regardless of riders_offered: a new rider must prefill before its KV can be seeded to the host, prefill needs resident blocks, and HBM is full of the 16 residents. See paper/BLOCKER_PREFILL_RESIDENCY.md. The r=4 and r=8 rows therefore measure degradation, not a 4- or 8-rider cost.
This supersedes the linear fit in paper/data/hide_efficiency.json (9.6 ms + 4.7 ms/req, implying 78% overlap), which differenced goodput runs that still contained prefill.
